title: HsB YBA Scripts
script:
There are many scripts I was talking about, but for a quick lucky arrow hop script, here it is:

Also, we encourage you to read the script features, so you know what you're working with.

getgenv().FarmShinyMasks = false
getgenv().HopAfterTime = 20
getgenv().webhooklink = ""
getgenv().Update = "keyhere"
getgenv().ping = ""
loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/senS24t/sensnebunu/main/LuckyArrowHop"))()
features:
# Hsb Cat Club's Scripts and there features:
Lucky Arrow Hop (Free):
v v
: Efficient Farming: The script will farm Lucky Arrows. Thousands of successful results can be seen in the "lucky-arrows" channel in the Discord server (Passive)

: Customizable Settings: Users can choose the time interval between server hops and specify whether they want to farm Lucky Arrows or Shiny Masks. (Toggle)

: Webhook Integration: The script supports the option to add a webhook, allowing users to receive notifications or pings over specific events (Toggle)

Auto Prestige (Free):
v v
: Automated Prestige: This script automates the process of leveling. (Passive)

: Vampire Support: Users have the option to face vampires during the farm process to provide support for certain stands. (Passive)

: Improved: This script was recently re-worked, making it more efficient

: Webhook Integration^.

Shiny Farm (Free):
v v
: Shiny Farming: The script can automatically farm any shiny in the game by user's choice. (Passive)

: Ribs Farming: Depending on wanted shiny, the user can enable or disable this option. (Toggle)

: Custom Support: The user can manually insert any other shiny that was newly introduced into the game by following the config template.

: Early Play Option: Users can enable early play, which will speed up the farming process. (Toggle)

: Webhook Integration^.

Auto MIH (Free):
v v
: Made in Heaven Automation: The script automatically obtains the Made in Heaven stand for the user. (Passive)

: Customizable Moves: Users can choose the moves they want the script to use. (Toggle)

: Server Hopping: If other players are nearby, the script automatically hops to a different server. (Toggle)

: Webhook Integration^

Auto TWOH (Free):
v v
: The World Over Heaven Automation: The script will obtain The World Over Heaven stand. (Passive)

: Complete 1v1 and SBR Sections: It automates the completion of both the 1v1s and Steel Ball Run (SBR) parts of the game. (Passive)

: Evade Mods: The script will change server if a moderator is found. (Passive)

: Webhook Integration^.

Stand Farm (Free):
v v
: Custom Support: The script enables farming of any wanted stand from the list. (Toggle)

: Early Play^

: Webhook Integration^

Pity Farm (Free):
v v
: Pity Farming Automation: This script will farm the desired pity set by the palyer. Utilizing ribs as the primary resource.

: Hybrid Farming: Users have the option to use arrows until halfway through the desired pity and then switch to ribs for more efficient farming.

: Early Play^

: Webhook Integration^

Multiple Items Farm (Free):
v v
: Item Farming: The script allows users to farm multiple items of their choice. They can add, remove, or replace any item by following the template. (Toggle)

: Low Mode: Users can enable low mode to reduce CPU usage by enabling lower graphics (Toggle)

: Early Play^

: Webhook Integration^

Auto 1v1 (Free):
v v
: Automated 1v1 Matches: The script will hide and wait until the opponent will leave. (Passive)

Auto SBR (Free):
v v
: Automated Steel Ball Run: The script will attempt to complete the Steel Ball Run for the user. Note: This script is very old and discontinued, there may be crashes during the usage. (Passive)
Lucky Arrow Hop Premium (Buyers):
v v
+ Faster Farming: The premium version of Lucky Arrow Hop offers even faster results compared to the free version. (Passive)

+ Customizable Player Threshold: Users can specify the number of playercount servers they want to hop for enhanced farming efficiency. (Double numerical values)

+ Improved hopping method: This script will use an advanced hopping method (Passive)

: Webhook Integration:^

Auto Tusk Pity Farm(NEW, FREE)
v v
: **THE WHOLE PROCESS OF HOW THE SCRIPT WORKS IS IN THE DISCORD'S CHANGELOG CHANNEL FOR MORE ACCURATE DETAILS**

: Basically will farm pity so you won't get a skin, therefore increasing chances of getting the skin you want by having higher pity, less risk, and of course a little bit more time

+ StopAtMoney (Number): On phase 2 (see discord for more info^) it will stop selling coins once that threshold of the money is reached and will start doing arcades

+ This script currently doesn't have any buyer benneficials, but if I see more interaction and activity from people I will work harder to make the free version better and release things for buyers too!

Auto TWOH Premium (Buyers):
v v
+ Faster SBR Completion time: The script will use a different and faster method to complete the SBR quest. (Passive)

OP 1v1 (Buyers):
v v
+ Unreportable and Unbannable: This script ensures the user's safety. (Passive)

+ Dual Account System: Users will utilize two accounts and select which account wins or loses in the 1v1 matches. The losing account will automatically reset once the game started. (Passive)

+ Guaranteed Win: Each 1v1 match is a guaranteed win. (Passive)
